title: Slow to Anger, Great in Kindness

youtube_full.title: Slow to Anger, Great in Kindness | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Joel 2:12–13
youtube_full.description:
Slow to Anger, Great in Kindness: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Joel 2:12–13.

Joel told the people what Heavenly Father said. It was a hard, hungry time, and many had turned away.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Beau the Brave.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: Slow to Anger, Great in Kindness
1:11 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Beau the Brave
1:48 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
2:55 Question time
3:14 Sweet dreams
3:32 More stories, the app and the paperback
